definition: [ סָחַף ] verb prostrate (Late Hebrew סחף , Aramaic סְחַף (for ἐδαφίζω , Luke 19:42 ); Assyrian sa—âpu , throw down, overwhelm ); — Qal Perfect מָטָר סֹחֵף Prov 28:3 a prostrating rain (beating down grain), וְאֵין לָ֑חֶם and (so) there is no bread . Niph`al Perfect 3 masculine singular נִסְחַף אַבִּירֶיךָ Jer 46:15 why are thy mighty ones (or, why is thy bull , i.e. Apis, Hi Ew Gf ) prostrated? but read perhaps נָס חָף אַבִּירְךָ לאֹ עָמַד ( ᵐ5 Mich Gie Co ) why hath Apis fled, thy bull doth not stand?
